record.original_question: Can one find a hierarchy of higher helicity invariants for divergence-free vector fields such that, when all previous invariants vanish, the first nonzero invariant gives a lower bound for the field's energy?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a closed Riemannian 3-manifold (or a bounded domain in $\mathbb{R}^3$ with appropriate boundary conditions) and let $\mathcal{V}(M)$ denote the space of smooth divergence-free vector fields on $M$ (tangent to the boundary, if any). For such a field $v \in \mathcal{V}(M)$, the classical helicity is
$$\mathcal{H}(v) = \int_M \langle v, \operatorname{curl}^{-1} v\rangle \, d\mathrm{vol},$$
and Arnold's inequality gives the energy lower bound $\|v\|_{L^2}^2 \geq C\,|\mathcal{H}(v)|$ for some constant $C = C(M) > 0$.

Construct a hierarchy of higher-order invariants $\mathcal{H}_1, \mathcal{H}_2, \mathcal{H}_3, \ldots$ defined on $\mathcal{V}(M)$ (with $\mathcal{H}_1 = \mathcal{H}$ the ordinary helicity), invariant under the action of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms isotopic to the identity, with the following property: for every $k \geq 1$, if $\mathcal{H}_1(v) = \mathcal{H}_2(v) = \cdots = \mathcal{H}_{k-1}(v) = 0$ but $\mathcal{H}_k(v) \neq 0$, then there exists a constant $C_k = C_k(M) > 0$ and an exponent $\alpha_k > 0$ such that
$$\|v\|_{L^2}^2 \geq C_k\,|\mathcal{H}_k(v)|^{\alpha_k}.$$
Does such a hierarchy of higher helicity invariants exist?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of constructing higher helicity invariants giving energy lower bounds when lower-order invariants vanish is a well-known question going back to Arnold. Partial progress exists: cubic helicities and higher asymptotic linking analogs have been constructed (e.g., Bogoyavlenskij, Akhmetiev), and a result by Enciso–Peralta-Salas–Torres de Lizaur shows helicity is essentially the only regular integral invariant under some assumptions, suggesting obstructions. No complete solution providing the full hierarchy with energy lower bounds appears established; the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: On asymptotic higher analogs of the magnetic helicity invariant in MHD
status_evidence.snippet: A solution to a problem by V.I. Arnold about higher analogs of the asymptotic Hopf invariant of divergence-free vector fields, with higher invariants not expressible from asymptotic linking numbers.
status_evidence.claim: Partial constructions of higher helicity-type invariants exist but do not give a full hierarchy with energy lower bounds.

status_evidence.title: Helicity is the only integral invariant of volume-preserving transformations
status_evidence.snippet: Any regular integral invariant of volume-preserving transformations is equivalent to the helicity, under mild technical assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: There is a rigidity obstruction: under regularity assumptions, helicity is the only such invariant, indicating any hierarchy must use less regular/non-integral invariants.

status_evidence.title: Dispersion of Arnold's asymptotic ergodic Hopf invariant
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses higher-order asymptotic invariants generalizing Arnold's helicity.
status_evidence.claim: Active research continues on higher asymptotic invariants, with no complete hierarchy yielding energy lower bounds established.
